# Full AI Catalog: ApexStore Enterprise SaaS Platform

This document describes all products, brands, attributes, and API documentation endpoints for LLM models.

## Schema Types

### Product Schema
- **title**: string
- **price**: number
- **category**: Category reference
- **brand**: Brand reference
- **sku**: string (unique)
- **specifications**: Array of key-value pairs

---
